AGR Pedals browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal AGR Pedals OD85 - Full Range Overdrive Published on December 29, 2025 AGR Pedals overdrive pedal Information The AGR Pedals OD85 Full Range Overdrive is an analog overdrive effect pedal designed to deliver a high range overdrive response while preserving the complete character of the instrument signal. It functions as a transparent boost, emphasizing the full frequency spectrum rather than selectively coloring or compressing the sound. The circuit is voiced to maintain clarity and definition, allowing the natural tone of the instrument and amplifier to remain prominent. The OD85 is distinguished by its dynamic response, enabling greater control over how the overdrive reacts to playing intensity. This responsiveness allows players to modulate the amount of drive and saturation directly through touch and picking dynamics, supporting expressive performance control. The pedal is designed to enhance the signal without obscuring articulation, making it suitable for applications where transparency and responsiveness are required. The control layout consists of three precision controls that allow straightforward adjustment of gain structure, tonal balance, and output level. These controls provide the means to dial in subtle boost settings or higher gain overdrive textures while retaining the full range character of the input signal. Controls Gain : Adjusts the amount of overdrive applied to the signal. Tone : Shapes the overall tonal balance of the overdrive effect. Volume : Sets the output level of the pedal. Highlights Analog full range overdrive design. Transparent boost character that highlights the complete instrument signal. Dynamic response for enhanced control through playing technique.
